## Validation

List exact commands/checks executed, results, and untested device/browser cases. Include screenshots for visual changes using fictional contacts only.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No unexpected networking, telemetry, or personal data in fixtures/logs
- [ ] Offline and subpath behavior considered
- [ ] Accessibility and both interface languages considered
- [ ] Lockfile and third-party notices updated when dependencies change
- [ ] Tests and documentation reflect the resulting behavior
